workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation host preflight command composition IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority has host runtime preflight facts and a validation command result contract, but command callers still need to thread preflight.runtimeSelection into runtimeSelection manually. A narrow command-composition lane can consume already admitted host preflight facts without adding OS discovery or runtime execution.

splitDecision.reason: Host preflight command composition is the smallest useful step after the pure host preflight adapter. It closes the command-chain handoff without opening OS scanning, runtime locator invocation, runtime validation execution, compare execution, LabVIEWCLI execution, Docker orchestration, terminal process wiring, package/bin publication, release, Marketplace, or source copying.
splitDecision.commandCompositionBoundary: compose supplied public-safe host preflight facts or a ready host preflight result into the existing validation command result
splitDecision.hostPreflightBoundary: host candidate discovery remains supplied-facts-only; no filesystem walk, registry probe, PATH probe, environment probe, or private path discovery
doNotAdmitTogether: file writes from the host preflight adapter
